title: Three Phase Charters
specs: Explore Great South Bay including Fire Island, state boat channel, beaches, bridges, and scenic views

includes: Licensed jetski operator accompanies all rentals
gap: Exact prices for jet ski tours and boat charters not stated
blurb: Guests rent jet skis with a licensed operator accompanying them. They receive a safety briefing and operate their own jet ski within a designated area or on guided tours exploring various water routes. Boat charters are available for cruising, sightseeing, and water sports with custom packages for groups.
extraNote: $500 deposit per jetski required, charged only if damage occurs · Arrive 20-30 minutes before rental · Reservations recommended but not required; weekends busy · Must stay within sight of staff operator during rental · Full refund if raining before departure; 50% discount if raining during ride; rides proceed if drizzling · Burns Park Boat Ramp - 4990 Merrick Rd., Massapequa or another agreed location. · 2024 season
